version: 0.1.0
kind: workspace-folder
metadata:
  name: .projects_data
  description: Volatile project data products, imports, and generated state that should not be versioned.
spec:
  path: .workspace/.projects_data
  lifecycle: volatile
  tracking: ignored
  volatility: high
  naming:
    reserved_files:
      - _root.yaml
      - "*.data.yaml"
    versioning: semver
